# axiz-core-commons

Framework-neutral operational contracts: transaction boundaries and outcomes, deployment environments, transport security policies, and generated-code and reviewed-state markers.

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-core-commons</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

The version is managed by `axiz-bom` (services inherit `axiz-parent-service`).

## Main types

| Type | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Environments` | Operational profile of a deployment (`axiz.config.environment`). |
| `Generated` | Marks a class written by a generator, not by a person (the models openapi-generator produces from the contract of a service); JaCoCo leaves such classes out of the coverage gates. |
| `TransactionRunner` | Runs work inside a transaction (Spring: `TransactionTemplate`). |
| `TransactionOutcome` | Evidence about a local transaction; rollback does not prove absence of external effects. |
| `ReviewedState` | Records review of shared mutable state; it does not prove immutability or thread safety. |
| `TransportSecurityPolicy` | Immutable transport boundary; plain HTTP requires an explicit exception in local/test/ci. |
| `DataTransportSecurityPolicy` | TLS and peer verification policy for data stores, independent of their client technology. |

Related types: `AsyncLoadingCache`, `BoundedCallbackExecutor`, `Stages` live in `axiz-core-concurrent`; `ApiResponse`, `HeaderCatalog`, `HeaderDefinition`, `Page`, `PageMetadata`, `PageRequest`, `PageResponse`, `Sort`, `StandardHeaders` live in `axiz-core-api`; `RequestContext`, `RequestMetadata` live in `axiz-core-context`; `JsonReader`, `JsonWriter` live in `axiz-core-json`.

## Tests

Unit tests live in `src/test/java` and document the expected behavior; run them with `./mvnw -pl core/axiz-core-commons verify`.

## JDBC

The JDBC implementation and SQL resources live in `axiz-kit-jdbc`; this module contains
framework-neutral contracts and orchestration, and `TransactionRunner` lives in
`pe.axiz.core.commons.tx`. A service adds the JDBC adapter of a capability with `axiz add` (or the
Initializr); see [JDBC boundaries](../../arquitectura/jdbc.md).

## Language helpers

`Checks`, `Strings`, `Dates` and `Result` live in
[`axiz-core-lang`](axiz-core-lang.md), package `pe.axiz.core.lang`. A domain that only
needs these helpers depends directly on that JDK-only module.
